interpretation.positive: Learned causal likelihood symbol grounding on genuinely unseen 4-valued public action IDs beat the fully trained independent raw-symbol Beta predictor and arbitrary identity-hash native source learner in late unknown-action adaptation, in both frozen DEV cohorts. This indicates some transferable, persistent learned binary intervention relation structure is being reused after novel identity introduction.
interpretation.negative: Exact Bayesian posterior over balanced 4-token to binary actuator assignments, using the SAME source-trained causal prototype and genuine source evidence, outperformed the independent per-token grounder in both DEV cohorts. Candidate early unfamiliar-action prediction was weaker than strongest exact control by approximately 0.02298 and 0.02165. Required >=.015 pooled superiority cannot be met, so scientific DEV_NO_GO.
interpretation.cold_retention: Original known action semantics returned for 48 episodes; native and source causal checkpoints remained source-persistent and exact restored; candidate cold-return Brier near 0.1274 and 0.1263 versus original native-hash control 0.15746 and 0.15963. This does NOT prove general cold retention on unrelated held task families.
interpretation.fairness: Candidate and exact Bayesian control trained on identical genuinely observed source outcomes and had the same native/causal source history budget, with both receiving the same 96 supervised-by-public known canonical actions, 144 entirely unseen symbols and 48 known-action return events. An exact balanced mapping prior is an explicit extra modeling assumption, not a source label. Training compute is NOT matched.
interpretation.structural_caveat: The new labels 10..13 are new, but each hides an underlying member of the PREEXISTING TWO actuator primitive classes; learner does not discover an entirely new action effect. It is a bounded semantic binding task, not open-world symbol semantics or all-action general intelligence.
interpretation.strongest_control_nonoracle: Privileged evaluator-only true mapping oracle ceiling never trains. The strongest eligible, nonprivileged fitted control is exact_balanced_mapping, not oracle_known_mapping.

limits: Synthetic stochastic binary causal worlds, two rule families; no genuinely novel physical primitive semantics or real-world grounding.
Original Yggdrasil accepted public API only supports 0/1 actions. CKAD46 is an isolated learned adapter; cannot be represented as native production capability.
No strong-control scientific qualification or independent held first use; consumed DEV 46111/46112 are not reusable as confirmatory evidence.
Absolute Brier gains versus some weaker conventional controls do not imply strong-control improvement.
No matched process compute; exact Bayesian mapping enumerates 36 hypotheses; no performance/efficiency superiority claim.
No full final regression, accepted owner integration, deployment, runner/scheduled task/controller change, merge or main alteration.
stop_and_next: Stop CKAD46 (DEV_NO_GO). Preserve learned source and original receipts. Priority should be a bounded native action-schema proposal that can represent genuine higher-cardinality primitive semantics and compositional causal relations; then prequalify under unseen intervention families against exact posterior and fully trained conventional controls, not more symbol-ID approximations on consumed seeds.
